Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning stop work orders on projects that require hydraulic project approval.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to compliance with the hydraulic project approvalrequirements; amending RCW 77.15.300; adding a new section to chapter77.55 RCW; and repealing RCW 77.15.140.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.55 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: If any person or government agency fails to follow the requirementsof obtaining hydraulic project approval under this chapter or fails tocarry out any of the requirements or conditions of a hydraulic projectapproval issued under this chapter, the department's regional programmanager responsible for overseeing the regional hydraulic projectactivities at any point prior to the approval of a hydraulic projectapproval may issue a stop work order to that person or governmentagency. The stop work order must set forth the specific nature,extent, and time of violation, the damage or potential damage, a noticethat the violation must stop, and, in appropriate cases, the specificcorrective action to be taken within a specified time. Within twentydays of service of a stop work order or other order or as provided byrule of the department extending the time, the person may file a p. 1 SSB 6368written petition with the department appealing the order, and thispetition must be treated as an application for an adjudicativeproceeding under chapter 34.05 RCW. In the event of an appeal, aperson or government agency may seek interim relief from a stop workorder or other order under this section as provided in chapter 34.05RCW.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 77.15.300 and 2000 c 107 s 239 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as otherwise provided in this section, a person orgovernment agency is guilty of unlawfully undertaking hydraulic projectactivities if the person constructs any form of hydraulic project orperforms other work on a hydraulic project and: (a) Fails to have a hydraulic project approval required underchapter 77.55 RCW for such construction or work; or (b) Violates any requirements or conditions of the hydraulicproject approval for such construction or work. (2) Unlawfully undertaking hydraulic project activities is a grossmisdemeanor. (3) The commission may, by rule, identify categories of acts thatviolate the hydraulics code, chapter 77.55 RCW, and may classify suchacts as infractions, punishable under RCW 77.15.160. (4) This section does not apply to: (a) Activities that are the subject of a stop work order issuedunder section 1 of this act and the person does not violate such anorder; or (b) Activities for which an infraction has been issued undersubsection (3) of this section.
RCW 77.15.140 (Unclassified fish orwildlifeUnlawful takingPenalty) and 1998 c 190 s 15 are eachrepealed.
